fact: 1935年10月3日意大利未宣战即从厄立特里亚入侵埃塞俄比亚；埃塞军队在戈拉海等据点顽强抵抗，阿法瓦尔格·瓦尔达·萨马亚特11月7日重伤后意军才占领戈拉海。11月17日卡萨公爵2万人与塞尤姆公爵1.5万人在迈梅西奇河谷会合。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Second Italo-Ethiopian War
sources.quote: At 5:00 am on 3 October 1935, De Bono crossed the Mareb River and advanced into Ethiopia from Eritrea without a formal declaration of war... Only after Afawarq was mortally wounded on 7 November did the Italians capture Gorahai. On November 17, 20,000 men of Ras Kassa Haile Darge joined Ras Seyoum 15,000 Tigrayans.

fact: 1935年11月18日国联对意大利实施制裁，但英国不封锁苏伊士运河、未涵盖石油煤炭钢铁，埃塞俄比亚未能获得有效国际支持。海尔·塞拉西皇帝后来流亡英国，通过国际联盟呼吁援助。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Second Italo-Ethiopian War
sources.quote: the United Kingdom did not block the Suez Canal to Italian ships, allowing the war to continue and the Italian economy did not suffer, because the sanctions did not concern vitally important materials such as oil, coal and steel.

fact: 1935年埃塞俄比亚为独立君主国，海尔·塞拉西皇帝在位；意大利入侵后，埃塞军队以部族武装与正规军混合抵抗。占领前资产转移与国际援助通道在1935年10月后开始收紧。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Second Italo-Ethiopian War
sources.quote: The Italians faced steady Ethiopian resistance by the troops of Afawarq Walda Samayat in the valley of the River Fafan, at Gorahai.

fact: 1935年埃塞俄比亚为前现代农业国，军队以步枪、机枪与厄利孔高炮抵抗意大利摩托化纵队、坦克与轰炸机。战争导致平民流离失所，具体物价与工资数据未在本包取得。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Second Italo-Ethiopian War
sources.quote: The 20 aircraft involved were hindered by the Oerlikon cannons and by the ability of the Ethiopians to disperse rapidly across the terrain.

fact: 埃塞俄比亚军队缺乏现代工业基础，武器多为进口步枪与机枪；意大利使用摩托化纵队、坦克与皇家空军轰炸机。技术差距在1935年战役中决定了正面战场胜负，但埃塞抵抗力量通过分散与地形利用限制意军空中打击效果。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Second Italo-Ethiopian War
sources.quote: Rodolfo Graziani began the southern campaign by deploying mobile columns of motorized troops supported by tanks and the Regia Aeronautica... hindered by the Oerlikon cannons and by the ability of the Ethiopians to disperse rapidly across the terrain.

fact: 意大利入侵前，埃塞俄比亚的国际贸易与援助通道主要通过吉布提铁路与亚的斯亚贝巴；1935年10月后，意大利从厄立特里亚与意属索马里两面入侵，占领前资产转移与平民撤离窗口极短。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Second Italo-Ethiopian War
sources.quote: De Bono crossed the Mareb River and advanced into Ethiopia from Eritrea... Graziani began the southern campaign by deploying mobile columns of motorized troops.

fact: 埃塞军队在戈拉海、迈梅西奇河谷等据点顽强抵抗，阿法瓦尔格11月7日重伤；意军在后续战役中使用毒气（本包未取得直接引文，列为资料缺口）。平民在战争中流离失所。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Second Italo-Ethiopian War

fact: 1935年埃塞俄比亚货币为塔勒（Maria Theresa thaler）与本国铸币；意大利入侵后，国联制裁未能有效阻止意大利，埃塞俄比亚的国际援助通道在1935年11月后实际关闭。
